psd.scope: All statistics are descriptive for two independent EDR acquisitions. 79 spatially correlated segments are NOT 79 independent events. Segment-bootstrap intervals, Wilcoxon p-values and pixel-level KS p-values do not establish event-level significance.

real_holdout_against_satellite.scope: Distinct actively selected sectors nested within two events, not independent space-weather realizations; conditional DDPM does not uniformly outperform OVATION or interpolation.
